recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the approved datatype-based structure and removes misleading leftovers from the old HealthcareService.notAvailable/availabilityExceptions model without reopening the rejected location-under-availability proposal.
issue_request: FHIR-9260 asked to restructure HealthcareService availability; its Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution says R5 made availability consistent across the specification by using a datatype, while not adopting every originally proposed nesting change.
initial_application: No FHIR-9260-tagged source commit was found. The practical application came through the PA availability-family work, especially commit 447e89f4a40f92d16f33490766f29b9bce017236 for FHIR-25381/FHIR-26641, which introduced the Availability datatype and replaced HealthcareService.availableTime, HealthcareService.notAvailable, and HealthcareService.availabilityExceptions with HealthcareService.availability.
additional_context: FHIR-25381 explicitly created the shared Availability datatype for HealthcareService, Location, and PractitionerRole. Later PA changes refined the shared shape, including FHIR-36017's single HealthcareService.availability instance and FHIR-41311's Availability.availableTime.period refinement, which is already represented on the combined branch. A Zulip discussion confirms the purpose was consistency across directory resources.
reconciliation: Updated HealthcareService.active wording, its Participant mapping exception, the checked-in HealthcareService SVG title, and the fhir.ini R4/R5 change annotation so current build inputs now point to HealthcareService.availability.notAvailableTime instead of stale notAvailable spelling.
source_changes: source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml: updated HealthcareService.active definition to direct maintenance/holiday closures to HealthcareService.availability.notAvailableTime.
source/healthcareservice/healthcareservice-participant-mapping-exceptions.xml: synchronized the Participant mapping exception text for HealthcareService.active.
source/healthcareservice/healthcareservice.svg: synchronized the checked-in diagram title for HealthcareService.active with the corrected definition.
source/fhir.ini: corrected the HealthcareService.availabilityExceptions R4/R5 change annotation target to HealthcareService.availability.notAvailableTime.description.

related_jiras.note: Created the shared Availability datatype and explicitly replaced HealthcareService's prior availability elements with an availability property.
Related Location closure/not-available semantics were applied in the same commit that introduced the shared Availability datatype.
Later PA source change made HealthcareService.availability cardinality 0..1 in the current build.
Later Applied PA issue refined Availability.availableTime.period and is already represented on the combined branch.
Triaged cross-version Availability mapping concern found during search; not final and not decided here.
